allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Rajoo Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release titled "Rajoo Engineers Ltd Successfully Raised ₹160 Crore through Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP)".

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Rajoo Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 14678900 securities pursuant to Qualified Institution Placement at its meeting held on July 21, 2025

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Rajoo Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on July 21, 2025 for closure of QIP

allot.subject: Qualified Institutional Placement
allot.text: Rajoo Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange about qualified Institutional Placement

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Rajoo Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on July 15, 2025 for opening of issue of Qualified Institutions Placement
